            current = [deepcopy(value)]
        previous = value

import unittest
from solution import group_adjacent


class GroupAdjacentTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_returns_maximal_consecutive_groups(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            group_adjacent([1, 1, 2, 1, 1, 1, 3]),
            [[1, 1], [2], [1, 1, 1], [3]],
        )
        self.assertEqual(group_adjacent(["only"]), [["only"]])
        self.assertEqual(group_adjacent([]), [])

    def test_uses_equality_not_identity(self):
        first = [1]
        second = [1]
        self.assertEqual(group_adjacent([first, second, [2]]), [[[1], [1]], [[2]]])

    def test_input_is_unchanged_and_every_element_is_independent(self):
        shared = {"items": [1]}
        values = [shared, shared]
        result = group_adjacent(values)
        result[0][0]["items"].append(2)
        self.assertEqual(shared, {"items": [1]})
        self.assertEqual(result[0][1], {"items": [1]})
        self.assertIsNot(result[0][0], result[0][1])

        another = group_adjacent(values)
        result[0][1]["items"].append(3)
        self.assertEqual(another, [[{"items": [1]}, {"items": [1]}]])

    def test_rejects_non_list_input(self):
        for value in [None, (), "abc", {"a": 1}]:
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    group_adjacent(value)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
